CMS SupaTrak.evidence: CMS SupaTrak Limited entered administration in September 2025 according to UK Companies House filings, and its fleet telematics services have since transitioned under the Connected Management Services brand (cms-fleet.com).

Trackyou Limited.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, Trackyou Ltd was incorporated under company number 04203244 and officially changed its name to UK Telematics Limited in 2017. The company remains active in the telematics sector, providing vehicle and asset tracking systems as shown on its website.
